sentences.text: On February 8, 2024, Michael O'Higgins FX Class Representative Limited withdrew its application.
On September 2, 2024, the U.K. Supreme Court scheduled a hearing of the appeal for April 1-2, 2025.
Beginning in 2011, several individual and putative class actions were filed against the Corporation, BANA, and certain Merrill Lynch entities, as well as other banks on the U.S. Dollar LIBOR panel.

Defendants' motion for summary judgment is pending on all remaining claims, brought by individual plaintiffs and one class of plaintiffs who purchased over-the-counter instruments incorporating LIBOR.

comparisons.peer_summary: GS&Co faces a securities class action regarding ON24's $492 million February 2021 IPO; the court granted dismissal with prejudice in March 2024, and plaintiffs appealed to the Ninth Circuit in April 2024.
comparisons.comparison: Both C and GS are defendants in securities-related litigation involving class actions, though the underlying matters differ significantly. C is a defendant in a UK Competition Appeal Tribunal matter regarding FX manipulation, which is currently at the UK Supreme Court appeal stage scheduled for April 2025. GS is a defendant in a U.S. securities class action regarding the ON24 IPO; while the district court dismissed the case with prejudice in March 2024, plaintiffs appealed to the Ninth Circuit in April 2024. Both disclosures highlight significant appellate activity in April 2025/April 2024 respectively, but one is an FX antitrust/class action appeal in the UK and the other is a securities law appeal in the US.
